URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/iran-guards-say-oil-tanker-exploded-after-hitting-mine-in-unauthorized-route-through-hormuz/
Times of Israel liveblog (newsroom entry), fetched 08:20 BST via WebFetch; entry stamped Saturday 17 October 2026, 5:03 am Israel time (03:03 BST)

Iran's Revolutionary Guards say that an oil tanker exploded and caught fire after hitting a naval mine while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian media reports.

The report says the tanker was carrying over 2 million barrels of crude oil and was attempting to illegally transit the strategic waterway through a route unauthorized by Iran.
